lessons.title: 1. Smart Pointers & RAII
lessons.description: Use `std::unique_ptr` and RAII patterns for automated memory management. Implement `makeHeapInt(int value)` returning a `std::unique_ptr<int>` that owns a heap-allocated copy of `value`; prefer the `std::make_unique` factory.

tests.name: test_unique_ptr
tests.unittest_code:
auto ptr = makeHeapInt(42);
if (!ptr || *ptr != 42) throw std::runtime_error("Smart pointer failed");

source.name: cppreference.com — std::unique_ptr — smart pointer that owns and disposes its object

learning_objectives: Explain RAII: std::unique_ptr disposes its object when it goes out of scope
Allocate a managed heap object with std::make_unique<T>(value)
Dereference a std::unique_ptr with * like a raw pointer
